The net revisions of the previous two months to the nonfarm payroll report are a popular metric in gauging the labor market's trend.
-
*US OCT. TWO-MONTH PAYROLL NET REVISION ADDS 84,000

The top panel (blue) shows cumulative two-month payroll revisions.

The bottom panel shows the two-month net revisions.

For years, net cumulative revisions (top panel) declined, potentially signaling that the underlying labor market trend was weaker than initially reported.

But consider these cumulative net revisions
* 2025 (Jan to Sept) = -998K
* 2026 (Jan to Sept) = -28K

If negative revisions are slowing, maybe the underlying trend of the labor market is improving?
